description.en: Plays a "next episode" trailer/preview panel: stops the map BGM and fades to black, loads and shows a background image plus an episode-specific preview image and voice-over, animates the preview in, waits for the voice-over to finish, then cleans everything up.
Episode ID, used to build the preview image and sound file paths.
Number of preview image variants available for this episode.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
